description: Fails on master: Lukoil gives two rows, top_index_brand:ru_лукоил of Belarus (Q329347) and top_index_brand_lukoil of Lithuania (no brand:wikidata, so the rows are not deduplicated by TYPE_Q and not linked through byWikidataKey). Expected is one row (the one with the Q stays), and лукойл lists the Lithuanian stations as well. The extract belarus_minsk_brands is cut out of Belarus_minsk_europe_2.obf: the 8 POIs nearest to Minsk of each value of brand / brand:xx of Belarusbank and Lukoil, up to 5 POIs per alternative name that produce it (the name of the POI equals the brand and one of its name:xx is that alternative), and the 6 nearest plain atm, bank and fuel POIs. lithuania_lukoil holds the 4 stations of Lithuania tagged brand=Lukoil without brand:wikidata (overpass-api.de, 2026-11-13; ways are written as nodes at their centers).
